arms.cluster_qa: Contiguous visual scenes + center retrieval + original QA
arms.temporal_local: Same entry scene + summary-derived temporal entity network + original QA
arms.summary_deep: Progressive summary search + independent scene-local entities + original QA
arms.temporal_cross: Same evidence as summary_deep + cross-stage identity and entity history + original QA

cohort_provenance.rule: original100 sampled excluding two debug IDs, then 200 from seeded shuffle of remaining400

experiment.repair_policy: Keep original attempts; reference valid successes; fresh budgets are separate attempts, not resumed budgets
repair_changes: Three entities per observation page, bounded sparse states, metered smaller timeout retries
Bind retry entity names to supporting original caption IDs
Exclude and record unsupported optional relations/causes
Preserve literal source newlines; regenerate malformed structured output from canonical IDs
Parse unambiguous explicit QA declarations; cancel original QA at its deadline

limitations: One question per GPU; GPUs 6 and 7 shared with existing workloads; GPU 5 baseline was measured earlier.
Estimated combined throughput assumes independent scheduling and stable contention; no formal work was moved.
Cold total includes frozen artifact preflight; pair_wall_seconds excludes model loading.

cost_notes: Valid result costs exclude historical failed attempts, queueing, shared offline preprocessing and process-level startup.
temporal_cross total_measured_seconds includes original shared evidence preparation; its wall_seconds measures incremental replay work.
Partial accuracy uses completed rows; accuracy_final remains null until the full cohort is complete.
This is a read-only snapshot of the experiment, not a new evaluation run.
